findings.issue: Systemsucht is more distinctly pejorative than 'passion for systematization'. The English softens the suspicion that the grammarians' excessive system-making produced some of the rules.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'the grammarians’ passion for systematization' with 'the grammarians’ excessive zeal for systematization'.
findings.German_basis: The conjecture attributes the rules 'wenigstens zum Theil der Systemsucht der Grammatiker'; Sucht marks an excessive tendency.

findings.issue: The antecedent of seine in 'erhält seine Freiheit' is not secure. Rhythm or quantity from the preceding sentence is a plausible referent: aesthetic predominance would preserve its freedom against intellectual emphasis. The English 'it preserves its freedom' more readily suggests aesthetic feeling's own freedom. This is an unresolved interpretive concern, not a demonstrated mistranslation.
findings.proposed_fix: Retain provisionally without claiming that the antecedent has been settled. If the contextual rhythm reading is adopted, use 'preserves the freedom of rhythm alongside the emphasis of the connection of thoughts'.
findings.German_basis: The preceding sentence concerns Rhythmus and 'dem ruhigen Walten des Zeitmasses' asserting its right; the next says 'Das Vorherrschen des aesthetischen Gefühls ... erhält seine Freiheit'. The possessive can grammatically refer to rhythm, quantity, or aesthetic feeling.

findings.issue: 'Deviations can be recognized in spelling' can locate the deviations in spelling itself. The German presents spelling as the evidence by which deviations are recognized, within an argument about pronunciation transmitted between generations.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'deviations can be recognized in spelling' with 'deviations can be detected by reference to spelling'.
findings.German_basis: 'Abweichungen lassen sich an der Rechtschreibung erkennen': an marks the diagnostic evidence in the construction etwas an etwas erkennen.

auditors.whole_unit_assessment: All 120 supplied IDs were assessed in order as one division: 108 main-text blocks, two headings, and ten attributed notes. The translation is substantially faithful and readable. I found no major omission, reversal of negation, or disruption of the central distinctions between sound inventories, syllable and word formation, quantity, accent, intonation, and alphabetic writing. Two minor wording fixes and one unresolved antecedent concern are reported. Historical linguistic and evaluative assertions are retained as the author's claims, including those concerning Sanskrit, Chinese, and national cultivation. The checked German governs this assessment; the uncorrected whole-work OCR was background only. I acknowledge the provisional 1906 base and the coordinator's reported image comparison, without claiming independent image verification, manuscript collation, extension of D001's cancellation report to this division, or specialist human certification. The local deletion reports remain editorially attributed and are not restored to the main text.

findings.issue: rein/reine Geschiedenheit and rein geschieden are rendered as clear/clearly, shifting purity of separation to clarity and conflating rein with Klarheit, inconsistently with Reine Bestimmtheit rendered pure in p59:s3.
findings.proposed_fix: Use pure/purely separated consistently, e.g. lack of pure separation; pure separation of the basic sounds; purely separated wholes.
findings.German_basis: mangelnder reiner Geschiedenheit; reinen Geschiedenheit der Grundlaute; reinen Scheidung der Töne; rein geschiedene Ganze; rein geschieden vorkommen

findings.issue: Veränderung and Verwandlung are both collapsed into change/changing, erasing a recurrent German lexical contrast the audit was warned not to modernize away.
findings.proposed_fix: Distinguish consistently, e.g. Veränderung as alteration/change and Verwandlung as transformation, or retain one pairing throughout and note the choice.
findings.German_basis: Verwandlung zusammenstossender Consonanten; Buchstabenveränderung; Buchstabenverwandlung; Lautverwandlung

findings.issue: Ton, Laut and Schall are flattened toward sound; p71:s2 loses the Ton/Schall contrast, and Tongebiete is narrowed to accentual domains.
findings.proposed_fix: Preserve contrasts where they carry argument, e.g. tone for Ton in p57:s1 and p71:s2, audible sound only for Schall, tone-domains for Tongebiete.
findings.German_basis: Absonderung des Tones; Tongebiete; articulirte Ton; Gebiete des immer vergehenden Schalles

findings.issue: Recurrent Geltung is rendered variously as force, sway, standing and significance, and ideale Geltung becomes conceptual force, losing the cross-block thread of validity/efficacy and the ideal/ideational term.
findings.proposed_fix: Use a consistent equivalent such as standing/efficacy for Geltung, and ideal (ideational) standing for ideale Geltung.
findings.German_basis: ideale Geltung der Sprache; ganze Geltung des Zeitmasses; selbständige Geltung; Verstandesgeltung

findings.issue: The zu...als dass nicht...sollte construction is split and sollte becomes must, strengthening and flattening the negated modal necessity.
findings.proposed_fix: Render as too closely akin for its formation not to exert..., for this not to show itself in turn..., and for an interaction...not to arise.
findings.German_basis: zu enge mit dem Geiste verschwistert, als dass nicht...ausüben, dass dieser sich nicht wieder...zeigen, und...nicht eine...Wechselwirkung entstehen sollte

findings.issue: durch sie is resolved as Inflection, whereas the pronoun may refer more immediately to individual letter-change in p61:s3; English antecedent choice is not certain.
findings.proposed_fix: Use through this letter-change the double advantage is gained, or retain a pronoun whose antecedent matches the German ambiguity.
findings.German_basis: Es wird aber durch sie der doppelte Vorzug gewonnen

findings.issue: Bracketed Systematic Account of the Sanskrit Language is an added gloss for the title and renders Lehrgebäude loosely as account.
findings.proposed_fix: Delete the gloss or mark it as translator gloss with System for Lehrgebäude.
findings.German_basis: Bopp's Lehrgebäude der Sanskrita Sprache

findings.issue: Glossing der as the misrepresents its genitive function in the context of p62:s1.
findings.proposed_fix: Deleted after der: einander nahe liegenden, translated lying close to one another, without glossing der as the.
findings.German_basis: Nach „der“ gestrichen: „einander nahe liegenden“.

findings.issue: tried to disregard adds attempt where wollte is volitional/hypothetical neglect.
findings.proposed_fix: a foreigner who wished to neglect it / were to neglect it would not be understood at all
findings.German_basis: der Fremde, welcher dieselbe vernachlässigen wollte, gar nicht würde...verstanden werden

findings.issue: individuellen is transferred from habits to tribes, changing scope from individual/particular habits of tribes to habits of individual tribes.
findings.proposed_fix: depends on the individual habits of the tribes

findings.issue: Present does for elliptical Sanskrit comparison shifts the past-tense claim about Greek word-joining.
findings.proposed_fix: Thiersch maintains that the Greeks joined words, as in Sanskrit / as Sanskrit did.
findings.German_basis: dass die Griechen, wie das Sanskrit, die Wörter verbanden

findings.issue: erscheint...nicht is rendered as is not made...by this means, introducing causative making for appearance.
findings.proposed_fix: word division does not appear, by this means, in purely separated clarity to the senses

findings.issue: Zeitmass as bare Quantity adopts later classical-prosody terminology and obscures the time-measure sense active in p65:s6; defensible but not transparent for historical vocabulary.
findings.proposed_fix: At first use give time-measure (quantity), thereafter quantity if desired.

findings.issue: Dropping nicht in ob...nicht auch neutralizes the negative-question bias toward suspecting short e and o existed.

findings.issue: language taken in isolation adds taken and weakens unverbundenen, i.e. language apart from connected discourse.

findings.issue: alsdann is resolved as when they do combine, but its nearest textual antecedent is the negative alternative; the English logic is plausible yet interpretively certain where German is compressed.
findings.proposed_fix: Retain for in that case one element necessarily predominates, avoiding an explicit when-they-do-combine clause.

findings.issue: whose fullness is due to its less frequent use makes an explicit causal claim from the compressed weil phrase; the parallelism supports it, but German does not state the causal verb in that form.
findings.proposed_fix: Prefer alongside the full, less usual form unless the causal reading is editorially confirmed.
findings.German_basis: neben der ausführlichen, weil weniger üblichen Form, eine zweite häufiger gebrauchte, abgekürzte

findings.issue: Eingehen in das Ganze becomes investigation, importing the noun from Sprachuntersuchung in p56:s1 and losing entering into/engaging with.
findings.proposed_fix: and entering into the whole of the language system always remain deficient
findings.German_basis: das Eingehen in das Ganze des Sprachsystems

findings.issue: Gliederung is rendered organization into parts here, against articulation for Gliederung in p64:s3 and p64:s8, weakening a key cross-block membering/articulation thread.
findings.proposed_fix: the idea of its articulation into members gains greater life within it
findings.German_basis: die Idee ihrer Gliederung lebendiger in ihm wird

findings.issue: gemeinsten Volksklassen as lowest social classes turns commonest into lowest in rank.
findings.proposed_fix: to the commonest classes of the people
findings.German_basis: bei den gemeinsten Volksklassen

findings.issue: does not in every language wholly shed is scope-ambiguous in English between not in all and in none, where German nicht in allen Sprachen indicates not in all.
findings.proposed_fix: in not every language does it wholly and purely lose its original nature
findings.German_basis: verliert aber nicht in allen Sprachen (28.) seine ursprüngliche Natur ganz und rein

auditors.whole_unit_assessment: Provisional 1906 printed base acknowledged; checked German governs and whole-work OCR was treated as uncorrected background only; no manuscript collation or expert human certification is claimed. All 120 IDs in division 56-71 including 62a/b, both headings and ten attributed source notes were assessed. The translation is overall faithful, readable and precise, preserves negations, hedges such as wohl/mag/vielleicht, historical claims as claims, and editor versus author attribution without restoring deleted matter. No wholesale replacement is warranted. Material issues are local and mostly minor terminological consistency matters concerning rein geschieden, Veränderung/Verwandlung, Ton/Laut/Schall, Geltung and Gliederung, plus a few modal, scope and antecedent points and two note glosses; Zeitmass, p61:s4, p68:s4 and the Sanskrit-pronoun note remain genuine uncertainties rather than proven errors.

dispositions.resolution: Accepted. Use excessive zeal for systematization to preserve the pejorative Sucht without turning the conjecture into an established accusation.

Unresolved and retained provisionally. Both rhythm/quantity and aesthetic feeling are grammatically possible. Keep its freedom, with a local translator note explicitly naming the alternatives and no claim that the antecedent has been settled.
Accepted. Use deviations can be detected by reference to spelling, making Rechtschreibung the diagnostic evidence rather than necessarily the location of the deviations.

Retained with qualification. Rein geschieden describes the distinctness of sounds; clear separation is idiomatic in these local contexts and is supported by the conditional term rule. Pure/purely is kept where the text predicates purity, not imposed mechanically on every rein. The German lexical pattern remains recoverable.

Declined as an invariant lexical distinction. The neighbouring Veränderung/Verwandlung compounds overlap in these contact-change contexts; the guide records all four German terms and the word-versus-sound bearers. No source-based contrast requires a blanket English change/transformation distinction.

Retained with explanation. Ton is sound where musical pitch is not at issue; Schall is separately audible, transient sound in71. Tongebiete is accentual domains in the immediately preceding explanation of prominence grouping. The guide exposes the historical overlap instead of creating a false modern tone distinction.

Declined as a fixed-equivalent rule. Geltung has different bearers here: conceptual efficacy, quantity’s sway, a word’s independent standing and significance for the understanding. The conditional termbase distinguishes them; a recurring-term entry makes that relationship explicit.

Accepted in part. Remove must from the second English sentence while preserving the first too-closely...not construction and the causal continuation. Splitting the long construction remains an English readability choice; no temporal or conditional clause is dropped.

Accepted as an unresolved antecedent. Replace Inflection thus brings with This brings, leaving the preceding letter-change/inflection relation open. The double advantage is preserved; the apparatus retains the alternatives.
Accepted. Retain the citable German book title and remove the added bracketed English title gloss from Humboldt’s note.

Accepted in part. Remove the isolated English gloss of der and retain the exact German anchor in the note. The deleted modifier is translated in full and its German wording remains in original source-note metadata; it is not restored into the main text.
Accepted. Use a foreigner who were to disregard it for the hypothetical wollte, removing the added suggestion of an attempted but unsuccessful disregard.
Accepted. Use particular habits of the tribes, keeping the modifier on habits rather than transferring it to tribes.
Accepted. Use joined words, as in Sanskrit, avoiding an extra English tense choice for the elliptical comparison.

Retained. The through-this-means construction itself supplies the causal relation; not made clear to the senses is an idiomatic equivalent of erscheint...nicht...durch dies Mittel. No extra causal agent or claim is introduced. The sensory and boundary qualifications remain.

Retained with guide. Quantity is an established readable rendering of temporal quantity and is defined locally as timing and duration, not assumed to mean mere amount or vowel length alone. It remains distinct from accent. No modern theory is silently assigned to the historical term.
Accepted. Restore whether the living language did not also possess a short e and o, preserving the negative-question orientation as well as uncertainty.
Accepted. Use language outside connected discourse to clarify unverbundenen without turning the parts themselves into a new type of isolated language.

Qualified, interpretation retained. In the surrounding argument, one element’s predominance explains conceptual union, not failure of union. Keep when they do combine, while a local translator note explicitly records that alsdann is compressed and the alternative attachment is possible.

Declined omission of weil. The causal connective is explicit in the German; the source-based reading preserves fuller because less usual. The final wording can be less cumbersome, but may not silently reduce the cause to a coordinate property or reverse it.
Accepted in part. Replace investigation of the language system with engagement with the language system; this preserves Eingehen without repeating Sprachuntersuchung from the previous block.
Accepted. Use articulation into parts in71, retaining the Gliederung thread and its local operation without mechanically substituting the same phrase for all contexts.

Qualified. Gemeinsten can denote the socially lowest or most ordinary/common classes in this historical context. Use commonest classes of the people to avoid an unnecessarily sharp rank claim while retaining the social-class reference. No neutral modern sociological label is attributed to Humboldt.

Retained. Does not in every language means not in all, as in the German; it does not assert in none. The contrast and subsequent finding in both African and highly developed languages make the scope explicit. No awkward inversion is necessary.
